approval: 2026-08-30 explicit instruction: Trabaja en la task P1.A2
objective: Implement proof-only deterministic synthetic seed storage with a redacted count/digest receipt, close-before-delete, verified absence, and a bounded abandoned-run janitor.
acceptance: HP-A2: deterministic fixture writes and hashes inside exactly one valid proof run directory; the receipt reveals byte count and SHA-256 only; all handles close, that directory is deleted, and absence is verified.
EC-A2: traversal or foreign path and write/hash/close/delete failures fail closed; only valid marked stale runs below the proof root are eligible for janitor deletion.
No discovery, Hyperswarm, replication, product P2PService call, or persistent product state is introduced.
constraints: ADR-043: only Paths.cache/dubbridge-p2p/proofs/<run-id>; close handles before delete; verify nonexistence; janitor is bounded after crash.
P1.A1b.0: host passes the sole file: URI through Bare.argv[0]; URI/path, keys, fixture content, and raw errors do not enter RPC receipts or logs.
A cleanup failure cannot produce PASS. Android evidence is redacted and must not claim resolution of X28.
out_of_scope: P2PService, normal product startup, public API, durable identity or storage
user media, keys, HTTP, iOS, Android X28 remediation
verification: focused transient-seed Jest test covering HP-A2 and EC-A2
npm run build:bare-worklet and npm run check:bare-worklet
npm run typecheck, npm run lint, and full mobile Jest
known_environment_constraint: X28 remains an Android Bare-runtime device-proof blocker caused by upstream bare-module@6.3.2 inside react-native-bare-kit@0.15.0; it is not an Ollama issue.
